shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && cat AGENTS.md && find .agents -type f | head -50

sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo ---- && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo ---- && find src -type f -exec sh -c 'echo "== $1"; cat "$1"' _ {} \; && cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts && echo ---- && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/ | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head

rg -n -C 12 'page-constructor' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n 1,120p; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json && grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json; echo ----; timeout 25 npm view @gravity-ui/page-constructor version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -30

timeout 280 npm install @gravity-ui/page-constructor@^8 @diplodoc/transform@^4 2>&1 | tail -8; echo ----; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs; cat $D/INDEX.md | head -120; echo ----; ls $D/blocks $D/sub-blocks $D/guides; echo ----; rg -n -C 3 'Required setup|styles.css|PageConstructorProvider' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs; echo "=== Header"; cat $D/blocks/Header.md; echo "=== Hero"; head -40 $D/blocks/Hero.md; echo "=== CardLayout"; cat $D/blocks/CardLayout.md; echo "=== BasicCard"; cat $D/sub-blocks/BasicCard.md; echo "=== Banner"; cat $D/blocks/Banner.md; echo "=== Vite in README"; rg -n -C 8 -i 'vite' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md | head -60; echo "=== styles.css size"; wc -c node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles/styles.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles/styles.scss; head -c 600 node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles/styles.scss; echo; ls node_modules/sass node_modules/vite-plugin-dynamic-import 2>&1 | head -3

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor; cat $P/styles/styles.css | head -c 1500; echo; echo "=== scss imports"; cat $P/styles/styles.scss; echo "=== dynamic imports in build"; rg -n "import\(" $P/build/esm --glob '*.js' | head -10; echo "=== exports"; rg -n '"exports"' -A 30 $P/package.json | head -50; echo "=== ButtonBlock theme"; rg -n "theme" $P/build/esm/models/constructor-items/common.d.ts | head -20; rg -n "ButtonProps|ButtonTheme|ButtonSize" -A 12 $P/build/esm/models/constructor-items/common.d.ts | head -60

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor; echo "=== index exports editor?"; rg -n "editor" $P/build/esm/index.js | head; echo "=== Provider props"; rg -n "interface PageConstructorProviderProps" -A 25 $P/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructor.d.ts $P/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/Provider.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -45; rg -n "LocaleContextProps" -A 6 $P/build/esm/context/localeContext/*.d.ts | head -20; rg -n "export declare enum Lang" -A 8 $P/build/esm/models/*.d.ts | head -14; echo "=== GravityIcon impl"; rg -n "gravity-ui/icons|icons\[" $P/build/esm/components/GravityIcon/*.js $P/build/esm/components/**/GravityIcon* 2>/dev/null | head; find $P/build/esm -iname '*gravityicon*' | head -3; echo "=== icons dep"; rg -n '"@gravity-ui/icons"' $P/package.json; echo "=== common block props"; rg -n "interface BlockBaseProps" -A 20 $P/build/esm/models/constructor-items/blocks.d.ts | head -30; echo "=== HeaderBlock centered/buttons types"; rg -n "interface HeaderBlockProps" -A 25 $P/build/esm/models/constructor-items/blocks.d.ts | head -32; echo "=== Vite ~ handling"; rg -n "startsWith\('~'\)" node_modules/vite/dist/node/chunks/*.js | head -5

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor; echo "=== Lang/Indent"; rg -n "enum Lang\b|type IndentValue|enum Theme\b" -A 7 $P/build/esm/models/*.d.ts $P/build/esm/models/**/*.d.ts | head -40; echo "=== GravityIcon"; F=$(rg -l "gravityIcon" $P/build/esm/components --glob '*.js' | head -3); echo "$F"; rg -n "icons|GravityIconProps" $P/build/esm/components/GravityIcon/GravityIcon.js 2>/dev/null | head; rg -n "type GravityIconProps" -A 6 $P/build/esm/models/constructor-items/common.d.ts; echo "=== content type"; rg -n "content:|PageContent" $P/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructor.d.ts | head -5; rg -n "export interface PageContent" -A 8 $P/build/esm/models/common.d.ts $P/build/esm/models/*.d.ts | head -12; echo "=== Banner/CardLayout/BasicCard types"; rg -n "interface BannerBlockProps|interface CardLayoutBlockProps|interface BasicCardProps" -A 14 $P/build/esm/models/constructor-items/blocks.d.ts $P/build/esm/models/constructor-items/sub-blocks.d.ts | head -70; echo "=== install devdeps"; timeout 240 npm install -D sass vite-plugin-dynamic-import 2>&1 | grep -E "added|error|ERR" | head -5

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor; echo "=== Lang/Indent"; rg -n "enum Lang\b|type IndentValue" -A 6 $P/build/esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head -24; echo "=== ConstructorItem/SubBlock typing"; rg -n "export type ConstructorItem|export type SubBlock\b|export type ConstructorBlock\b|export type Block\b|interface Childable" -A 6 $P/build/esm/models/constructor-items/*.d.ts $P/build/esm/models/*.d.ts | head -50; echo "=== icon names"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -iE '^(Clock|Persons|ChartColumn|ChartBar|FileText|Timer|Stopwatch|ListCheck|Person|LayoutHeader|Pulse|Calendar|ChartAreaStacked|Receipt|FileCheck|Group|Users)[A-Za-z]*\.js$' | head -30

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor; D=$P/build/docs; echo "=== SubBlockModels basic-card"; rg -n "BasicCard" $P/build/esm/models/constructor-items/sub-blocks.d.ts | head; echo "=== ExtendedFeatures"; sed -n 1,60p $D/blocks/ExtendedFeatures.md; echo "=== LayoutItem props"; rg -n "^\| " $D/sub-blocks/LayoutItem.md | head -20; echo "=== Lang"; rg -n "Lang\b" $P/build/esm/models/common.d.ts $P/build/esm/context/localeContext/localeContext.d.ts | head -5; rg -rn "declare enum Lang" -A 6 $P/build/esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head -10

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor; rg -n "interface ExtendedFeaturesItem|interface ExtendedFeaturesProps" -A 10 $P/build/esm/models/constructor-items/blocks.d.ts | head -30; echo "=== Lang uikit"; rg -n "enum Lang" -A 12 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -16 || rg -rn "declare enum Lang" -A 10 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head -14; echo "=== BannerCardProps"; rg -n "interface BannerCardProps" -A 14 $P/build/esm/models/constructor-items/sub-blocks.d.ts

rg -n "^body|box-sizing" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -5; rg -n "pc-banner-block__content|\.pc-banner-block\b" -A 6 node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/Banner/Banner.css 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/Banner/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/sub-blocks/BannerCard/ 2>/dev/null; rg -n "background" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/sub-blocks/BannerCard/BannerCard.css | head -5

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/sub-blocks/BannerCard/BannerCard.css | head -40; echo "=== animated default"; rg -n "animated" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructor.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/components/AnimateBlock/AnimateBlock.js | head -8; echo "=== vite tilde in sass"; rg -n "'~'" node_modules/vite/dist/node/chunks/dep-*.js | head -5

rg -oh "@import ['\"]~[^'\"]+" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles --glob '*.css' --glob '*.scss' | sort | uniq -c; ls node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/dist/css/yfm.css
grep -rhoE "@import ['\"]~[^'\"]+" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles --include='*.css' --include='*.scss' | sort | uniq -c
ls node_modules/url 2>/dev/null && grep -E '"(version|main)"' node_modules/url/package.json; grep -n '"url"' package-lock.json | head -3
timeout 200 npm install url 2>&1 | grep -E "added|ERR" ; grep -E '"(version|main)"' node_modules/url/package.json; ls node_modules/url/url.js >/dev/null && echo "url.js ok"

python3 - <<'EOF'
import re,io
p='vite.config.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""    alias: [
      { find: /^~@diplodoc\\/transform\\//, replacement: '@diplodoc/transform/' },
      { find: /^~@gravity-ui\\/uikit\\//, replacement: '@gravity-ui/uikit/' },
    ],""","""    alias: [
      { find: /^~@diplodoc\\/transform\\//, replacement: '@diplodoc/transform/' },
      { find: /^~@gravity-ui\\/uikit\\//, replacement: '@gravity-ui/uikit/' },
      // page-constructor импортирует Node-модуль `url`; в браузере подставляем polyfill.
      { find: /^url$/, replacement: 'url/url.js' },
    ],""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -n "url" vite.config.ts; timeout 280 npm run build 2>&1 | grep -vE "DEPRECATION|More info|^\s*[╷│╵]|^\s*$|node_modules/.*@import|^\s+@import|repetitive deprecation" | tail -25

grep -c "Url.prototype.parse\|function urlParse" dist/assets/index-*.js; grep -n "__vite-browser-external" dist/assets/index-*.js | head -2; echo "=== tsc"; npx tsc --noEmit && echo "tsc OK"; echo "=== git"; cat .gitignore; git status --short; git diff package.json
grep -c 'Parameter "url" must be a string' dist/assets/index-*.js; grep -o "javascript:[^,]*,.*mailto:" dist/assets/index-*.js | head -c 200; echo; rm -rf dist && echo "dist removed"

timeout 200 npx vite build --logLevel error 2>&1 | grep -v DEPRECATION | tail -3; grep -o "must be a string[^\"']\{0,20\}" dist/assets/index-*.js | head -3; grep -c "vite-browser-external" dist/assets/index-*.js; grep -o "javascript:\",\"javascript\",[^]]*" dist/assets/index-*.js | head -c 150; echo; rm -rf dist
